cues.text: Behind a chain-link fence, in green moonlight, Takaya aims a revolver at Ken.
Shinjiro throws himself in front of Ken. The bullet tears into his back.
Blood drops hang in the air. Ken stares.
Ken's hand reaches for the wound in Shinjiro's back.
Takaya keeps the gun raised.
Shinjiro collapses. Takaya stands over him.
The rest of S.E.E.S. run in.
Takaya turns and walks off into the dark.
Akihiko runs to him.
The team gathers around Shinjiro. Fuuka kneels by Ken.
Koromaru nuzzles Shinjiro's hand.
Shinjiro looks up at Ken.
Blood runs from his mouth.
His eyes half close.
Mitsuru lowers her eyes.
Shinjiro rests his hand on Koromaru's head.
Akihiko cradles him.
Akihiko grips his hand.
His eyes close. His hand slips and falls.
Silent faces: the hero, Aigis, Junpei.
Akihiko bows his head.
Shinjiro's head falls against Akihiko's chest.
Tears roll down Ken's cheeks.
He falls forward onto his hands.
A full moon hangs between the dark buildings.
The green glow fades away.
